title: Payments Schedule Clause: Level Difference on a Charged Cleaning and Damage Fees Charge
content:
**Clause.** The level-difference refund on a charged Cleaning and Damage Fees fee moved down while disputed or after it was upheld is the flat fee of the level moved from less the flat fee of the level moved to, rounded half up to the cent, and never below zero. The level moved from of a refund is the level of the latest level-difference refund already made on the charge, or the level the fee was charged at when none was made. The level moved to is the level the assessment holds.

## Where each level is read

| Level | Record |
|---|---|
| Level moved from, when a level-difference refund was already made on the charge | the level on the latest partial refund entry on the assessment ledger |
| Level moved from, when none was made | the level on the fee charge entry |
| Level moved to | the level the assessment holds |

## Flat fees

| Cleaning level | Flat fee |
|---|---|
| Cleaning Fee Level 1 (Minor) | $25.00 |
| Cleaning Fee Level 2 (Moderate) | $60.00 |
| Cleaning Fee Level 3 (Significant) | $100.00 |
| Cleaning Fee Level 4 (Major) | $150.00 |

## Level differences

| Level moved from | Level moved to | Level difference |
|---|---|---|
| Level 4 | Level 3 | $50.00 |
| Level 4 | Level 2 | $90.00 |
| Level 4 | Level 1 | $125.00 |
| Level 3 | Level 2 | $40.00 |
| Level 3 | Level 1 | $75.00 |
| Level 2 | Level 1 | $35.00 |

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

- A fee charged at Cleaning Fee Level 4 (Major), with no level-difference refund yet, on an assessment now held at Cleaning Fee Level 2 (Moderate): $150.00 less $60.00, that is $90.00.
- A fee charged at Level 4 whose latest level-difference refund was booked at Cleaning Fee Level 3 (Significant), on an assessment now held at Level 2: the level moved from is Level 3, so $100.00 less $60.00, that is $40.00.
